concerns.text: The analysis uses the 1982 ERA5 mean‑temperature grid as a proxy for ambient temperature experienced by participants in 2014‑2018 (see the ‘Scope Adjustment’ paragraph). This temporal mismatch means the predictor does not reflect the actual temperature at decision time, undermining the validity of any claim about “ambient temperature influence”. The methodology should either obtain a temporally aligned temperature source or explicitly re‑frame the research question to address long‑term climatic differences only.

The plan applies an Anderson‑Darling test for normality on deviance residuals of a mixed‑effects logistic regression (SC‑005). Logistic models do not assume normally distributed residuals; testing for normality is inappropriate and may lead to misleading diagnostics. Replace this with appropriate checks (e.g., Hosmer‑Lemeshow goodness‑of‑fit, calibration plots, or examination of Pearson/standardized residuals).
